Offices:

• Commander of the air force: Nilou (N1L0F4R)
• Commander of the navy: vacant
• Foreign minister: vacant - acting: President Kaveh (B3C4D5F)

Budget:
🏦 National treasury: 184,500 Nil
🛡 Defence fund: 96,300 Nil
📊 Cities pay 10% of their revenue to the nation; 30% of that goes to defence.
🚢 Export policy: arms go to our state and to treaty partners.
📅 Last period: 12,400 Nil came in from the cities, 3,720 Nil of it to defence.
🔧 Upkeep paid in full: 1,290 Nil.
⏳ The next defence period ends in 17m, at 14:52.

Forces:
▪️ Ground forces
  • Main battle tanks: 24
▪️ Air force
  • Stealth fighters: 3
  • Fighters: 12
▪️ Air defence
  • Long-range air defence: 2
🎯 Readiness: 95%
🔧 Upkeep every period: 1,290 Nil

The minister buys arms from defence companies with the defence fund, and the commanders station them. The president sets the budget; every change is public in city hall.
